blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI-generated images linked to news events and online claims can mislead audiences, enable fraud, or cause public controversy. We introduce WildAIGC-Bench, built through recurring collection across news websites, fact-checking sources, and related social media content. The pipeline combines broad coverage, timely updates, and human-verified labels through scheduled discovery, automatic screening and preliminary annotation, and human review of image-specific evidence. The benchmark contains 407 verified AI-generated or edited images, each accompanied by a source webpage link and an evidence summary. Images retain the conditions encountered online, including compression, screenshots, and recapture. Evaluation of dedicated visual detectors, multimodal large language models, and a simple Perception Encoder baseline reveals substantial recall gaps relative to existing benchmarks. WildAIGC-Bench provides both a practical detection challenge and a basis for continued data expansion and source-based verification. The dataset is released at https://github.com/YuZijian/WildAIGC-Bench.
blocks.zh: AI生成的与新闻事件和在线诉求相关的图像可能会误导受众,导致欺诈,或者引起公众争议. 我们介绍WildAIGC-Bench, 该管道通过定期发现、自动筛选和初步说明以及人对特定图像证据的审查,将广泛覆盖、及时更新和经人验证的标签结合起来。 该基准包含407个经核实的AI生成或编辑的图像,每个图像都附有源网页链接和证据摘要. 图像保留了在网上遇到的条件,包括压缩、截图和重获。 对专用视觉探测器、多模式大型语言模型和简单感知编码器基线的评价显示,相对于现有基准而言,存在很大的召回差距。 WildAIGC-Bench既为实际探测提供了挑战,也为数据的持续扩展和基于源的验证提供了基础. 数据集发布于https://github.com/YuZijian/WildAIGC-Bench.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Advances in image generation and instruction-based editing make it increasingly easy to fabricate images that resemble ordinary photographs [ 1 , 2 ] . When circulated in connection with news events, these images can become apparent evidence for misleading claims about people, actions, or public incidents. Even a local edit can change a scene’s meaning while preserving much of its photographic appearance. This creates a practical need for AI-generated content (AIGC) detection in everyday information flows, where plausible images may mislead users, enable fraud, or cause harmful public controversy.
blocks.zh: 在图像生成和基于指令的编辑方面取得的进展使得制作类似普通照片的图像越来越容易。 当与新闻事件相关联的传播时,这些图像可以成为误导人、行动或公共事件的明显证据。 甚至本地编辑也可以改变场景的意义, 这就产生了在日常信息流中发现AIGC(AIGC)内容的实际需要,其中假象可能误导用户,造成欺诈,或引起有害的公众争议.

blocks.en: Existing detection methods broadly fall into two groups. Dedicated visual detectors learn generation artifacts or use pretrained image representations for classification [ 3 , 4 ] . Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) combine visual analysis with language-based reasoning to predict authenticity and explain their decisions [ 5 , 6 ] . Benchmarks evaluate these methods across generators and image categories, as well as under image degradation [ 7 , 8 ] . In-the-wild benchmarks further include images from creative communities and social networks, or examine the effects of actual platform transmission [ 4 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有的检测方法大致分为两类。 专用的视觉探测器学习生成文物或使用预先训练过的图像表示法进行分类[3,4]. 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)将视觉分析与基于语言的推理相结合,以预测真实性并解释其决定[5,6]. 基准在发电机和图像类别以及在图像退化下对这些方法进行评价[7、8]。 模糊的基准还包括来自创意社区和社会网络的图像,或审查实际平台传输的效果[4,9,10,11].

blocks.en: Existing collections address diverse generation workflows and sharing conditions. A complementary concern is whether detectors recognize photographic forgeries encountered in news reports and online claims. Evaluating this setting requires finding relevant images as they circulate, establishing evidence of AI involvement, and retaining their acquired condition. A construction process that can continue discovering candidates is therefore valuable alongside the benchmark itself.
blocks.zh: 现有的收藏涉及不同的生成工作流程和共享条件. 一个补充的关切问题是,探测器是否识别新闻报道和网上指控中遇到的伪造照片。 评估这种环境需要找到流通的相关图像,建立AI参与的证据,并保留其获得的条件。 因此,一个能够继续发现候选人的建造过程与基准本身一起是有价值的。

blocks.en: We introduce WildAIGC-Bench to evaluate detection on photographic-looking AI imagery circulating around news events and online claims. Its construction follows reports across news websites, fact-checking sources, and related social media content, bringing together diverse events and forms of generation and editing. Scheduled tasks continually discover, screen, and preliminarily annotate new candidates as they circulate. Human reviewers then verify the labels against source evidence and decide which images to include; no AI-image detectors are used for selection.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍WildAIGC-Bench来评价对围绕新闻事件和在线诉求的图片外观AI图像的检测. 其构建遵循各新闻网站的报道,查清事实来源,以及相关社交媒体内容,汇集各种事件及生成和编辑形式. 计划任务不断发现、筛选和初步说明新候选人的流通情况。 然后,人类审查人员对照来源证据核实标签,并决定包括哪些图像;没有使用AI-图像探测器进行选择。

blocks.en: This workflow enables continued expansion while preserving a documented basis for each label. Images retain the compression, screenshots, recapture, and other conditions encountered online. Subsequent releases will broaden event coverage and add real-image controls, including original photographs underlying some AI recreations, enhancements, and edits.
blocks.zh: 这一工作流程能够继续扩展,同时为每个标签保留一个有文件记录的基础。 图像保留了在线上遇到的压缩、截图、回收和其他条件。 随后的发布将扩大事件覆盖面,并添加真实图像控制,包括一些AI娱乐,增强,和编辑的原始照片.

blocks.en: We evaluate dedicated visual detectors, including PE-Det, a simple Perception Encoder reference baseline, alongside MLLMs [ 12 ] . Every evaluated configuration has lower recall on WildAIGC-Bench than its external mean. The highest recall on processed images is 60.93%, leaving over one-third of the images undetected. Higher recall from some MLLMs is accompanied by elevated false-positive rates on real images in the external benchmarks, limiting their overall detection advantage.
blocks.zh: 我们评价专用的视觉探测器,包括PE-Det,一个简单的感知编码器参考基准,与MLLMs [12]. 每个被评价的配置在WildAIGC-Bench上的召回率都低于其外部平均值. 在已处理的图像中,最高的召回率为60.93%,使三分之一以上的图像没有被发现. 某些最低劳动保障金的回收率较高,而外部基准中真实图像的虚假阳性率较高,限制了其总体检测优势。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are: 1. A continuously operating construction pipeline. The pipeline delivers broad coverage, timely updates, and human-verified labels by combining recurring collection across sources with automatic screening and preliminary annotation, followed by human verification and quality control. 2. A benchmark of real-world news-related AI imagery. WildAIGC-Bench captures photographic-looking AI-generated and edited images circulating around news events and online claims, preserving real sharing conditions with human-verified labels and documented source evidence. 3. An analysis of detector limitations in real-world settings. Cross-benchmark evaluation reveals consistent recall gaps for visual detectors and MLLMs. Paired crop analysis and shared misses characterize challenges across image content, editing, and circulation conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是: 1.持续运营建设管线. 管道提供广泛的覆盖面、及时更新和经人验证的标签,办法是将跨来源的经常性收集与自动筛选和初步说明相结合,然后进行人力核查和质量控制。 2. 现实世界与新闻有关的AI图像基准。 WildAIGC-Bench捕捉图片外观AI生成和编辑的图像,围绕新闻事件和在线诉求进行传播,保留与经人验证的标签和有文件记载的源证据的真实共享条件. 3. 对现实环境中探测器局限性的分析。 跨基准评价显示,视觉探测器和MLLMs的召回差距始终存在。 在图像内容、编辑和流通条件方面存在挑战。

blocks.en: A continuously operating construction pipeline. The pipeline delivers broad coverage, timely updates, and human-verified labels by combining recurring collection across sources with automatic screening and preliminary annotation, followed by human verification and quality control.
blocks.zh: 持续运营建设管线. 管道提供广泛的覆盖面、及时更新和经人验证的标签,办法是将跨来源的经常性收集与自动筛选和初步说明相结合,然后进行人力核查和质量控制。

blocks.en: A benchmark of real-world news-related AI imagery. WildAIGC-Bench captures photographic-looking AI-generated and edited images circulating around news events and online claims, preserving real sharing conditions with human-verified labels and documented source evidence.
blocks.zh: 现实世界新闻相关AI影像基准. WildAIGC-Bench捕捉图片外观AI生成和编辑的图像,围绕新闻事件和在线诉求进行传播,保留与经人验证的标签和有文件记载的源证据的真实共享条件.

blocks.en: An analysis of detector limitations in real-world settings. Cross-benchmark evaluation reveals consistent recall gaps for visual detectors and MLLMs. Paired crop analysis and shared misses characterize challenges across image content, editing, and circulation conditions.
blocks.zh: 现实世界环境中探测器局限性分析. 跨基准评价显示,视觉探测器和MLLMs的召回差距始终存在。 在图像内容、编辑和流通条件方面存在挑战。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 AIGC Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 AIGC检测

blocks.en: Dedicated visual detectors approach AIGC detection through several complementary directions. Artifact-based learning captures transferable generation traces through augmentation or reconstruction-based contrastive training [ 13 , 14 ] . Representation-based approaches use pretrained features or combine semantic and low-level cues for classification [ 3 , 4 ] . Data-centric approaches align the content and processing characteristics of real and synthetic training images, reducing shortcuts unrelated to generation [ 15 , 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 专用视觉探测器通过几个互补方向接近AIGC探测. 基于人工的学习通过增强或基于重建的对比性培训获取可转移的生成痕迹[13,14]. 以代表为基础的方法采用事先训练过的特征,或结合语义和低层次提示进行分类[3,4]。 以数据为中心的方法使真实和合成训练图像的内容和处理特点一致,减少了与生成无关的快捷方式[15,16].

blocks.en: MLLM-based detection combines authenticity prediction with language-based analysis. Explanation-supervised approaches learn from artifact descriptions to connect predictions with visual evidence [ 17 ] . Reasoning-oriented approaches use structured supervision or reinforcement learning to develop evidence assessment, including planning, self-reflection, and reasoning across image and video inputs [ 5 , 18 ] . Perception-oriented approaches strengthen sensitivity to fine details, semantic anomalies, and pixel-level differences, then integrate these abilities into reasoning through distillation [ 6 ] . WildAIGC-Bench tests whether these visual and reasoning capabilities transfer to verified forgeries from real news events.
blocks.zh: 基于MLLM的检测结合了真实性预测和基于语言的分析. 解释监督方法从文物描述中学习,将预测与视觉证据联系起来[17]. 以理性为导向的方法利用结构化的监督或强化学习来进行证据评估,包括规划、自我反射和跨图像和视频输入的推理[5、18]。 以感知为导向的方法加强了对细细细节,语义异常,和像素水平差异的敏感性,然后通过蒸馏[6]将这些能力融入推理. WildAIGC-Bench测试这些视觉和推理能力是否从真实的新闻事件转移到经核实的伪造.

blocks.en: 2.2 AIGC Detection Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 AIGC检测基准

blocks.en: CNNDetection [ 13 ] and UnivFD [ 3 ] support evaluation across generation architectures. GenImage provides large-scale cross-generator and degradation tests [ 7 ] ; Synthbuster focuses on diffusion imagery [ 19 ] ; and EvalGEN includes newer generation architectures [ 16 ] . WildFake supports training and generalization analysis across diverse content and hierarchically organized generator types, architectures, weights, and versions [ 8 ] . AIGIBench broadens task coverage and includes social-network and creative-community content [ 20 ] . Many standard evaluations rely on clean generator outputs. Their results may not reflect detection after compression, screenshots, and recapture in real use; predefined degradation tests cover only selected aspects of these conditions.
blocks.zh: CNN探测[13]和UnivFD[3]支持跨代架构评价. GenImage 提供大规模跨源和降解测试 [7];合成器注重传播影像[19];EvalGEN包括新一代建筑[16]. 疯狂 假支持对不同内容和等级排列的生成器类型,架构,权重,以及版本的培训和概括分析[8]. AIGIBench扩大了任务范围,并包括社会网络和创意社区内容[20]. 许多标准评价依靠清洁发电机产出。 其结果可能不能反映在压缩、截图和回收后的实际使用;预定义的降解测试只涵盖这些条件的某些方面。

blocks.en: 2.3 In-the-Wild Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.3 实地基准

blocks.en: In-the-wild benchmarks target real-use conditions through online image collection or realistic sharing processes. Chameleon emphasizes realistic content from ArtStation, Civitai, and Liblib [ 4 ] . SynthWildX collects images from X [ 21 ] , while WildRF uses social-network imagery [ 9 ] . ITW-SM covers multiple social platforms, obtaining AI images from accounts and communities that openly share generated content [ 10 ] . MIRAGE includes online news, social media, and e-commerce scenarios alongside pipelines that combine multiple generation steps [ 22 ] . RRDataset examines actual platform transmission and screen capture and recapture [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 隐蔽基准通过在线图像收集或现实的共享进程,针对实际使用条件. Chameleon强调ArtStation,Civitai和Liblib[4]中的现实内容. SynthWildX收集X[21]的图像,而WildRF使用社交网络图像[9]. ITW-SM覆盖多个社交平台,从公开分享生成内容的账户和社区获取AI图像[10]. MIRAGE包括在线新闻、社交媒体和电子商务情景, RRDataset审查实际的平台传输和屏幕捕捉并重获[11].

blocks.en: Creator and AI-community collections can favor works showcasing generation capabilities, whose content may differ from everyday photographs despite appearing realistic. Simulated degradation and controlled sharing or recapture tests cover selected conditions rather than the varied histories of images already circulating online. WildAIGC-Bench instead follows actual news events and misleading claims to collect photographic forgeries, preserving their acquired condition. Every sample is manually verified and accompanied by a source link and AI evidence, connecting detection evaluation to documented real-world forgery scenarios.
blocks.zh: 创造者和人工智能社区集可以喜欢展示生成能力的作品,其内容可能与日常照片不同,尽管看起来是现实的。 模拟退化和受控共享或回收测试包括某些条件,而不是已经在网上传播的图像的不同历史。 WildAIGC-Bench转而跟踪实际的新闻事件和误导性的说法,收集照片伪造,保留其获得的条件. 每个样本都经过人工核查,并附有源链接和AI证据,将检测评价与记录的真实世界的伪造情况联系起来.

blocks.en: 3 WildAIGC-Bench: Construction and Continued Expansion
blocks.zh: 3 WildAIGC-Bench:建造和继续扩建

blocks.en: 3.1 Automatic Collection, Screening, and Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.1 自动收集、筛选和注释

blocks.en: The pipeline achieves broad coverage by following news reports, fact-checking websites, and related social media content across public figures, social affairs, disasters, and other widely discussed events (Figure 1 ). Scheduled tasks support timely updates by collecting and screening newly circulating candidates. They prepare preliminary annotations from source descriptions, creator disclosures, watermark evidence, and fact-checking findings. Human review checks these annotations before inclusion, producing human-verified labels for each release.
blocks.zh: 该管道通过跟踪新闻报道、事实核查网站以及公共人物、社会事务、灾害和其他广泛讨论的事件的相关社交媒体内容(图1),实现了广泛的报道。 排定的任务通过收集和筛选新分发的候选人来支持及时更新。 他们根据来源说明、创造者披露、水印证据和事实调查结果编写初步说明。 人类审查在纳入之前检查这些说明,为每次发布制作经人验证的标签.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : From recurring discovery to verified benchmark releases. Scheduled tasks collect, screen, and annotate candidates across online sources. Human verification and quality control determine inclusion, preserving source evidence and acquired image conditions. Continued collection supports broader releases with more AI images and planned real-image controls.
blocks.zh: 图1:从反复发现到核实的基准释放。 计划的任务收集、筛选和在网络来源中说明候选人。 人类核查和质量控制决定了包容、保存原始证据和获得的图像条件。 继续收集支持使用更多的AI图像和计划中的真象控制进行更广泛的发布.

blocks.en: The collection targets photographic-looking images tied to news events and online claims, including fabricated scenes and local edits that may mislead audiences, enable fraud, or cause public controversy. News context refers to an image’s documented circulation and associated claims, not proof that the depicted event occurred. Figure 2 illustrates this diversity.
blocks.zh: 藏品针对的是与新闻事件和在线诉求相关的图片外观图像,包括可能误导受众,导致欺诈或引起公众争议的编造场景和当地编辑. 新闻背景是指一个图像的有记录的流传和相关说法,而不是被描绘的事件发生的证明. 图2说明了这种多样性。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Representative samples from WildAIGC-Bench: fabricated events, scenes, and products (a–c, e–g); AI-generated fashion and advertising imagery (d, h); and local edits that add fires or replace people (i, j). Sources (linked by panel): (a) Maldita.es ; (b) CRHoy ; (c) AFP ; (d) H&M ; (e) Unexplained Mysteries ; (f) Snopes ; (g) Fact Crescendo ; (h) 4A Advertising ; (i) Lead Stories ; (j) Full Fact .
blocks.zh: 图2:来自WildAIGC-Bench的代表样本:捏造事件、场景和产品(a-c,e-g);AI生成的时尚和广告图像(d,h);添加火灾或替换人的当地编辑(i,j)。 资料来源(按面板链接): (a) Maldita.es; (b) CRHOY; (c) AFP; (d) H&M; (e) 未解释的谜团; (f) Snopes; (g) Fact Crescendo; (h) 4A广告; (i) 主要故事; (j) 完全事实。

blocks.en: 3.2 Human Annotation Verification and Quality Control
blocks.zh: 3.2 人的说明核实和质量控制

blocks.en: Human reviewers check whether each automatic annotation is correct and perform sample-level quality control to decide inclusion. Review checks whether the available evidence establishes AI generation or editing of the target image, rather than merely a false claim about an event. Accepted evidence includes creator disclosures, visible platform watermarks, and explicit fact-checking findings. Invisible-watermark evidence comes from detection results publicly reported by fact-checking organizations; our team does not independently rerun those tools.
blocks.zh: 人文审查人员检查每个自动注释是否正确,并进行样本级质量控制,以决定是否包含. 审查现有证据是否证实AI生成或编辑目标图像,而不仅仅是对某一事件的虚假指控。 接受的证据包括创作者披露、可见的平台水印和明确的事实检查结果。 无形的水印证据来自事实核查组织公开报告的检测结果;我们的小组不独立地重新使用这些工具。

blocks.en: Candidates with insufficient evidence or uncertain AI involvement are excluded. Human review also rejects obviously stylized artwork and unusable images while retaining the degradations encountered during real circulation. No AI-image detectors are used for sample selection. Each accepted sample is accompanied by a source webpage link and an evidence summary, making the basis for its label inspectable. Additional annotation details and an example appear in Appendix A.
blocks.zh: 证据不足或大赦国际不确定参与的候选人被排除在外。 人类审查还拒绝明显有型的艺术品和无法使用的图像,同时保留在实际流通过程中遇到的退化。 不使用AI-图像检测器进行样本选择. 每一个被接受的样本都附有源网页链接和证据摘要,使其标签可以检查。 附录A载有补充说明和一个例子。

blocks.en: 3.3 Versioned Release and Dataset Profile
blocks.zh: 3.3 版本发布和数据集配置

blocks.en: The current v1 release contains 407 AI-generated or edited images . New candidates undergo human verification and quality control before entering a subsequent release; evaluation results remain tied to a fixed version. We will release expanded versions with more samples and broader event and source coverage, and add real images, including original photographs corresponding to some AI-recreated, enhanced, or edited samples.
blocks.zh: 当前 v1 发布包含 407 AI 生成或编辑的图像 。 新候选人在进入随后的发布之前接受人核查和质量控制;评价结果仍与固定版本挂钩。 我们将发布更多样本和更广泛的事件和源覆盖的扩展版本,并添加真实图像,包括一些AI重制、增强或编辑样本的原始照片。

blocks.en: Each sample includes an acquired version ( raw ) and an evaluation version ( processed ). Where appropriate, a rectangular crop removes surrounding interface elements, comments, or explicit AI cues while retaining the target content; otherwise the image is unchanged. Preparation introduces no resizing, inpainting, or enhancement. There are 83 cropped images and 324 unchanged pairs; both versions are evaluated. Their acquired condition preserves the effects of online sharing, including compression, screenshots, and recapture.
blocks.zh: 每个样本包括一个已获得的版本(原始)和一个评价版本(已处理)。 在适当情况下,一个长方形的裁剪会在保留目标内容的同时删除周围的界面元素,注释,或明显的AI提示;否则图像不变. 准备工作没有增加大小、油漆或增强。 共有83幅裁剪的图像和324幅不变的对图;两个版本都经过评估. 其获得的状态保留了在线共享的效果,包括压缩,截图,以及回收.

blocks.en: Figure 3 summarizes the dataset profile. Median short-edge lengths are 716 pixels for raw and 700 pixels for processed images. Linked source pages span 78 website hostnames, covering diverse news and fact-checking outlets. The current benchmark is a positive-only challenge set evaluated by AI-image recall. Source evidence is used to verify AI labels; detection is evaluated solely from the images.
blocks.zh: 图3概述了数据集简介。 中间短长为原始的716像素,处理过的图像为700像素. 链接的源网页涵盖78个网站主机名,涵盖各种新闻和事实检查。 目前的基准是AI-image record评价的只有正面的挑战设定. 原始证据用于验证AI标签;检测只从图像来评价.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 实验和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: We evaluate DRCT [ 14 ] , DDA [ 16 ] , AIDE [ 4 ] , B-Free [ 15 ] , Effort [ 23 ] , PGC [ 24 ] , OmniAID [ 25 ] , and CO-SPY [ 26 ] as dedicated visual detectors. The MLLMs include specialized detectors—FakeVLM [ 17 ] , BusterX++ [ 18 ] , and Veritas++ [ 6 ] —and general-purpose models: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B [ 27 ] , Qwen3.8-27B [ 28 ] , and GLM-5.3-Flash [ 29 ] . Together with PE-336 and PE-518, all sixteen configurations cover the external benchmarks and WildAIGC-Bench. Open-source methods use public code and weights, with each method’s preprocessing and decision settings held consistent across benchmarks. Qwen3.6, Qwen3.8, and GLM use the same prompts as Veritas++.
blocks.zh: 我们评价DDC[14]、DDA[16]、AIDE[4]、B-Free[15]、努力[23]、PGC[24]、OmniAID[25]和CO-SPY[26]为专用的视觉探测器。 MLLM包括专门的探测器——假VLM [17],BusterX++ [18],和Veritas++ [6]——以及通用型号: Qune3.6-35B-A3B [27], Qune3.8-27B [28], GLM-5.3-Flash [29]. 连同PE-336和PE-518,所有16个配置都涵盖外部基准和WildAIGC-Bench. 开源方法使用公共代码和权重,每种方法的预处理和决策设置在基准上是一致的。 Qune3.6,Qune3.8,和GLM使用与Veritas++相同的提示.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Resolution and source profile. Left: short-edge distribution of the paired versions. Right: selected source websites, counted per image rather than per event or original platform; remaining sources, including CBS News and DW, are grouped as Other sources.
blocks.zh: 图3:分辨率和来源简介。 左:对称版本的短端分布. 右:选定的源网站,每个图像而不是每个事件或原始平台计算;其余的源,包括CBS新闻和DW,被归类为其他来源.

blocks.en: PE-Det baseline. Recent studies have reported advantages of PE representations for AI-image detection [ 30 , 31 ] . We fine-tune PE-Core-L/14 [ 12 ] with a two-layer classification head and focal loss [ 32 ] . Training uses the training splits of WildFake [ 8 ] , So-Fake-Set [ 33 ] , and WildRF [ 9 ] ; WildAIGC-Bench is excluded from training and model selection. PE-336 and PE-518 use input resolutions of 336 × 336 336\times 336 and 518 × 518 518\times 518 , respectively. Training uses random cropping together with appearance and compression augmentations; inference directly resizes images without cropping.
blocks.zh: PE-Det基线. 最近的研究表明,PE表示对AI-image检测的优点[30,31]. 微调PE-Core-L/14 [12] 双层分类头和焦损失 [32]. 训练使用"野生假"[8],"So-Fake-Set [33]"和"野生RF"的训练分裂. [9]; WildAIGC-Bench被排斥在培训和模型选择之外. PE-336和PE-518分别使用336×336\336\时和518×518\518\时的输入分辨率. 训练使用随机裁剪与外观和压缩增强;推论直接调整图像大小而不裁剪.

blocks.en: External evaluation covers the benchmarks in Table 2 . Visual detectors use complete evaluation sets. MLLMs use fixed 2,000-image subsets for EvalGEN, UnivFD, AIGIBench, Chameleon, and RRDataset; corresponding results are marked with † \dagger in Table 2 . The remaining external benchmarks, including ITW-SM, are evaluated in full. Both raw and processed versions of WildAIGC-Bench are evaluated in full.
blocks.zh: 外部评价涵盖表2中的基准。 视觉探测器使用完整的评价集. MLLMs对EvalGEN,UnivFD,AIGIBEnch,Chameleon,和RRDataset使用固定的2000-图像子集;相应的结果在表2中标记为\\dagger 。 全面评价了其余的外部基准,包括ITW-SM。 WildAIGC-Bench的原始版本和加工版本都得到了全面的评价.

blocks.en: AI-generated content is the positive class. We report recall and, where real images are available, FPR and balanced accuracy (BAcc). BAcc equally weights AI-image recall and real-image specificity. External mean recall equally weights all nine benchmarks, and mean FPR weights the eight with real images, excluding EvalGEN. Comparisons use each method’s fixed operating point rather than calibration to equal FPR, and external real images are not matched controls for WildAIGC-Bench.
blocks.zh: AI生成的内容是正类. 我们报告我们回顾,如果有真实的图像,则报告可追溯和平衡准确性(BAcc)。 BAcc同样重视AI-image召回和真实影像的特异性. 外部平均值对全部9个基准都进行同样加权,并指FPR对8个有真实图像的加权,不包括EvalGEN. 比较使用每种方法的固定操作点而不是校准等效的FPR,外部真实的图像对WildAIGC-Bench不匹配控制.

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance Across Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.2 跨基准业绩

blocks.en: Table 1 contrasts external performance with WildAIGC-Bench. PE-518 achieves the highest external mean recall, 93.51%, and lowest mean FPR, 2.70%. MLLM recall should be interpreted together with false positives: FakeVLM reaches 90.63% external mean recall with 45.30% mean FPR, whereas Veritas++ reaches 82.86% recall with 19.72% FPR.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了外部表现与WildAIGC-Bench. PE-518实现了最高的外部平均召回率,为93.51%,最低的FPR为2.70%。 MLLM召回应与假阳性解释:假VLM达到90.63%的外部平均召回,45.30%的FPR,而Veritas++达到82.86%的召回,19.72%的FPR。

blocks.en: Table 1 : External mean recall and FPR, and WildAIGC-Bench recall (%). The cropped subset reports recall before and after cropping on the same 83 images. Drop is external mean recall minus full-set processed recall, in percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表1:外部平均召回和FPR以及WildAIGC-Bench召回(%)。 收获的子集报告回顾在同一83幅图像上收获前后. 下降是指外部平均召回减去已处理的全部召回,以百分比计。

blocks.en: Table 2 : External evaluation (%): each paired entry reports BAcc ↑ \uparrow / FPR ↓ \downarrow . EvalGEN reports recall only. Bold marks the best displayed values; shading highlights PE baselines and mean BAcc.
blocks.zh: 表2:外部评价(%):每个对齐的条目报告BAcc \ oparrow / FPR \ \ ownarrow 。 EvalGEN的报告只提到。 粗体标记显示的最佳值;阴影突出显示PE基线和平均值BAcc。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports BAcc and FPR by benchmark, providing a joint view of fake-image detection and real-image errors. All evaluated configurations have lower WildAIGC-Bench recall than their external mean. The recall drops range from 21.87 to 70.41 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 表2按基准报告BAcc和FPR,提供了假象检测和真象误差的联合视图. 所有被评价的配置都比其外部平均值更低的WildAIGC-Bench召回. 召回率下降21.87至70.41个百分点。

blocks.en: 4.3 WildAIGC-Bench and Transfer Gaps
blocks.zh: 4.3 WildAIGC-Bench和转移缺口

blocks.en: On processed inputs, recall ranges from 13.02% to 60.93%. GLM-5.3-Flash achieves the highest recall but still misses over one-third of the AI images. Qwen3.8 reaches 52.83%, compared with Qwen3.6’s 35.63%. PE-518 drops from 88.40% recall on ITW-SM to 23.10% here, a 65.30-point gap; BusterX++ drops from 94.22% to 29.48%. These gaps show limited transfer to forgeries found through real events.
blocks.zh: 关于加工的投入,召回率从13.02%到60.93%不等。 GLM-5.3-Flash实现了最高的召回,但仍错过了三分之一的AI图像. Qwen3.8达到了52.83%,而Qwen3.6的35.63%。 PE-518从ITW-SM的88.40%回升下降到23.10%,差距为65.30点;Buster-QQ从94.22%下降到29.48%。 这些差距表明,通过真实事件发现的向伪造者的转让有限。

blocks.en: Increasing the PE input resolution from 336 × 336 336\times 336 to 518 × 518 518\times 518 improves external mean BAcc from 92.3% to 95.0% and WildAIGC-Bench processed recall from 20.15% to 23.10%. This comparison supports the benefit of higher input resolution for PE-Det, although it does not close the transfer gap. PE-518 achieves the strongest external mean BAcc but remains below several other detectors in WildAIGC-Bench recall, showing that strong performance on existing benchmarks does not ensure reliable detection of these event-related forgeries.
blocks.zh: 将PE输入分辨率从336x336x336xx518x518xx518xxx518的外部平均BAcc从92.3%提高到95.0%,WildAIGC-Bench处理的召回率从20.15%提高到23.10%. 这种比较支持了PE-Det更高的输入分辨率的好处,尽管它没有弥合传输缺口. PE-518实现了最强的外部平均值BAcc,但仍低于WildAIGC-Bench record中的其他几个探测器,表明在现有基准上的有力表现并不能确保可靠地检测出与事件有关的伪造行为。

blocks.en: On the 83 cropped images, recall improves for seven of ten visual detector configurations but declines for four of six MLLMs (Table 1 ). This suggests that isolating the target region can benefit visual classification, while surrounding context may aid some MLLMs’ judgments.
blocks.zh: 在83幅剪辑的图像中,十个视觉探测器配置中有七个有改进,六个MLLM中有四个有下降(表1)。 这表明隔离目标区域有利于视觉分类,而周围环境可能有助于一些MLLMs的判断.

blocks.en: 4.4 Shared Detector Blind Spots
blocks.zh: 4.4 共用探测器盲点

blocks.en: On processed inputs, 46.93% of images are missed by at least three-quarters of the evaluated detector configurations. Reviewing this subset and its source records reveals several shared characteristics. Scenes involving people recur throughout this subset, including posed group photographs, social gatherings, public appearances, sports, and law-enforcement activities. Other samples depict disasters, damaged infrastructure, conflict, and animal rescue. Their presentation resembles familiar forms of visual reporting: news photographs, personal snapshots, historical photographs, broadcast stills, and surveillance views.
blocks.zh: 在经过处理的投入中,至少四分之三的经评估的探测器配置错过了46.93%的图像。 对这一子集及其来源记录的审查揭示了几个共同的特征. 在这一小类中,人们参与的场景反复出现,包括展示群体照片、社交集会、公众露面、体育和执法活动。 其他样本描绘灾害、基础设施受损、冲突和动物救援。 他们的介绍类似于熟悉的视觉报道形式:新闻照片、个人快照、历史照片、广播静物和监视观点。

blocks.en: The subset spans both fabricated scenes and changes to existing photographs. Source records describe altered people, expressions, clothing, flags, and signs, as well as AI reconstruction of details from blurred footage. Visual quality also varies, from clear portraits and group photographs to low-light, blurred, or screenshot-based images. Shared misses therefore extend across content types, the extent of modification, and image quality levels, rather than being confined to visibly degraded inputs.
blocks.zh: 子集既包括编造的场景,也包括对现有照片的修改. 来源记录描述了被改变的人、表情、服装、旗帜和标志,以及AI从模糊的镜头中重建细节。 视觉质量也各不相同,从清晰的肖像和团体照片到低光度,模糊度,或基于截图的图像. 因此,共享的缺失涉及内容类型、修改程度和图像质量水平,而不是局限于明显退化的投入。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The current release is modest in size and focuses on forgeries collected through news and fact-checking contexts. It characterizes a challenging subset rather than the full distribution of online images, and currently lacks real-image controls. The planned expansion described in Section 3 will support paired comparisons, false-positive evaluation, and broader assessment of detection performance.
blocks.zh: 目前发行的规模不大,侧重于通过新闻和事实核查收集的伪造资料。 它的特点是一个具有挑战性的子集,而不是在线图像的完全发布,目前缺乏真实图像控制. 第3节所述的扩大计划将支持对等比较、假阳性评价和更广泛的检测业绩评估。

blocks.en: The reported results apply to the evaluated configurations. Image content and sharing conditions jointly contribute to the observed difficulty; we do not reconstruct each image’s complete sharing history or isolate individual degradations. We also lack a user study comparing detector performance and error patterns with human recognition.
blocks.zh: 报告的结果适用于评价的配置。 图像内容和共享条件共同造成观察到的困难;我们不重建每个图像的完整共享历史,也不孤立个别退化。 我们还缺乏将探测器性能和误差模式与人类识别进行比较的用户研究.

blocks.en: The source links and evidence summaries are unused in the current image-only evaluation. Future work will explore agents that actively search for relevant source evidence and combine it with visual analysis to verify image authenticity in real-world online settings.
blocks.zh: 源链接和证据摘要在目前仅图像评价中未被使用. 未来工作将探索积极搜索相关源证据的代理,并将其与视觉分析相结合,以验证真实世界在线环境下的图像真实性.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: WildAIGC-Bench combines a continuously operating collection pipeline with a benchmark of photographic-looking AI imagery from news events and online claims. Automatic collection, screening, and preliminary annotation are followed by human annotation verification and quality control for final inclusion. Continued collection will support broader releases with more AI images and real-image controls. All evaluated configurations have lower recall than their external mean; the highest processed recall is 60.93%. These findings motivate both continued benchmark expansion and detection systems that actively search for source evidence and combine it with visual analysis.
blocks.zh: WildAIGC-Bench将持续运行的收集管道与来自新闻事件和在线诉求的图片外观AI图像的基准结合起来. 自动收集、筛选和初步说明之后,再进行人的说明核查和质量控制,以便最终纳入。 继续收集将支持更广泛的发布,同时增加AI图像和真实图像控制. 所有被评价的配置的召回率低于其外部平均值;经过处理的召回率最高的是60.93%. 这些调查结果促使继续扩大基准和探测系统,积极寻找来源证据,并将其与视觉分析结合起来。

blocks.en: Appendix A Construction Workflow and Annotation Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 建筑工程流量和注释细节

blocks.en: The construction pipeline assigns collection, initial screening, and preliminary annotation to scheduled automatic tasks that are already running. Human reviewers then verify whether the automatic annotations are correct and perform quality control to decide whether each sample enters the benchmark. Automatic annotations remain provisional until this review is complete.
blocks.zh: 施工管道将收集、初步筛选和初步说明分配给已执行的预定自动任务。 然后,人类审查人员核查自动说明是否正确,并进行质量控制,以确定每个样本是否进入基准。 在本次审查完成之前,自动说明仍为临时说明。

blocks.en: Image-specific evidence. To verify an automatic annotation, reviewers check that the supporting evidence concerns the target image and establishes AI generation or editing. A false event claim alone is insufficient: a genuine photograph may also be shared with an incorrect description. Creator disclosures, visible platform watermarks, and explicit fact-checking findings can support admission. Invisible-watermark findings are taken from publicly reported fact-checking results rather than independent tool runs by the team. Candidates with insufficient evidence or uncertain AI involvement are excluded.
blocks.zh: 图像特异性证据. 为了验证自动注释,审查人员检查辅助证据是否涉及目标图像,并建立AI生成或编辑. 仅凭虚假事件索赔是不够的:真照片也可以与不正确的描述分享。 创建者披露,可见平台水印,以及明确的事实检查结论可以支持录取. 无形水印的调查结果取自公开报告的事实核查结果,而不是团队运行的独立工具。 证据不足或大赦国际不确定参与的候选人被排除在外。

blocks.en: Quality control and image preparation. Human reviewers make the final inclusion decision, excluding obviously stylized artwork and unusable images while retaining real circulation degradations. Accepted samples preserve their acquired image and supporting source information. A target-region crop removes peripheral text and interface elements where appropriate, while the raw image remains available for paired evaluation. No AI-image detectors are used for sample selection.
blocks.zh: 质量控制和图像准备。 人类审查人员作出最终的包容决定,同时排除明显具有风格的艺术品和无法使用的图像,同时保留真正的循环退化。 接受的样本保存其获得的图像和佐证来源信息。 目标区域裁剪可以酌情去除外围文字和界面元素,而原始图像仍可供对齐评价。 不使用AI-图像检测器进行样本选择.

blocks.en: Verification and cropping example. Figure A1 (b) shows the purported image of Imran Khan arriving at a hospital. Soch Fact Check reports a positive SynthID detection, supporting the AI label. The acquired screenshot also contains the uploader’s explicit AI-enhancement disclosure and a comment calling the image fake. MLLMs can read these peripheral statements and potentially infer the label without detecting manipulation in the target image, giving them an advantage over visual detectors that focus on image features. Cropping removes these direct textual clues and supports a more comparable assessment of the target content. Source evidence remains available for annotation verification but is not supplied separately to detectors.
blocks.zh: 核查和裁剪实例。 图A1(b)显示Imran Khan抵达医院的据称形象。 Soch Fact Check报告一个正合成ID检测,支持AI标签. 获取的截图中还包含了上传者明确披露的AI-增强功能,并有评论称画面是假的. MLLMs可以读取这些外围语句,并有可能在不检测到目标图像中的操纵的情况下推断出标签,使其比注重图像特征的视觉探测器具有优势. Cropping删除了这些直接的文字线索,并支持对目标内容进行更具可比性的评估. 原始证据仍可供注释核查使用,但不单独提供给探测器。

blocks.en: Continued collection and releases. The active pipeline continues to supply candidates while the current evaluation set remains fixed. Later releases will incorporate newly admitted samples and broaden coverage of events and information sources. Planned real-image additions include, but are not limited to, original photographs from which some AI-recreated, enhanced, or edited images were derived. This extension will enable paired source-image comparisons as well as evaluation of false positives.
blocks.zh: 继续收集和发行。 正在运行的管道继续提供候选人,而目前的成套评价仍保持不变。 其后的释放将包括新获得的样本,并扩大事件和信息来源的覆盖面。 计划中的真像添加包括但不限于一些AI重制,增强或编辑的图像衍生出来的原始照片. 这一扩展将使得能够进行对等的源图像比较以及对假阳性的评价。

blocks.en: Appendix B Paired Analysis of Cropped Images
blocks.zh: 附录B 栽培图像分析

blocks.en: This analysis uses the same 83 images before and after target-region cropping. The 324 unchanged pairs are excluded. Raw denotes the acquired online image; processed denotes the retained target region. No resizing, inpainting, or enhancement is introduced during sample preparation.
blocks.zh: 本分析在目标区域裁剪前后使用相同的83幅图像. 不包括324对不变的夫妇。 Raw表示获得的在线图像;处理后表示保留的目标区域. 在样品制备过程中,不引入重塑大小、涂料或增强。

blocks.en: Table A1 complements the recall comparison in the main paper with prediction transitions. A recovery is an image missed on raw input but detected after cropping; a loss is the reverse. Net recall changes can conceal substantial bidirectional changes: BusterX++ has nine recoveries and ten losses, yielding a net decrease of only one detection.
blocks.zh: 表A1补充了主要文件中的召回与预测过渡的比较。 恢复是原始输入上遗漏的图像,但在裁剪后被检测到;损失是相反的。 净召回变化可以掩盖实质性的双向变化:Buster QQ有9项回收和10项损失,导致净减少只有一项检测。

blocks.en: Table A1: Paired results on 83 cropped images. Recall and Δ \Delta are percentages and percentage-point changes, respectively; recoveries and losses are image counts.
blocks.zh: 表A1:83幅剪辑图像的Paired结果。 召回和\\Delta分别为百分比和百分点变化;回收和损失为图像计数。

blocks.en: Recall improves for seven of ten visual detector configurations and decreases for four of six MLLMs. For example, AIDE gains 19.28 points, while Qwen3.6 loses 12.05 points. Isolating the target region can benefit visual classification; removing surrounding text and interface context may remove useful cues for some MLLMs. Changes in framing and subsequent preprocessing also contribute to the comparison, so the paired results alone do not identify a single causal mechanism.
blocks.zh: 回顾10个视觉探测器配置中有7个改进,6个MLLM中有4个减少。 例如AIDE获得19.28分,而Qune3.6则失去12.05分. 隔离目标区域可以有利于视觉分类;删除周围的文本和界面上下文可以移除一些MLLM的有用提示. 框架和随后的预处理的改变也有助于比较,因此单是配对结果不能确定单一的因果机制.

blocks.en: B.1 Examples and Reasons for Cropping
blocks.zh: B.1 作物种植的实例和理由

blocks.en: (a) Removing surrounding post text
blocks.zh: (a) 删除周围的文字

blocks.en: Raw Processed
blocks.zh: 原始处理

blocks.en: The crop retains the fabricated Katy Perry Met Gala photograph and removes the post heading, hashtag, and surrounding margin. This separates the target image from the text asserting attendance. Source: Japan Fact-check Center . Detections change from 1 to 1 of 10 visual configurations and from 2 to 3 of six MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 作物保留了捏造的Katy Perry Met Gala照片,并删除了文章标题、标签和周边边距。 这把目标图像与声称出席的文本分开。 资料来源:日本实况调查中心。 探测器从10个视觉配置中的1个改为1个,从6个MLLM中的2个改为3个.

blocks.en: (b) Removing disclosure and comment context
blocks.zh: (b) 取消披露和评论内容

blocks.en: Raw Processed
blocks.zh: 原始处理

blocks.en: The crop retains the purported hospital-arrival image and removes the Instagram caption, engagement interface, and comments. The removed text explicitly discloses AI enhancement and includes a comment calling the image fake. The source reports a positive SynthID check; this is source-reported verification, not a tool run by our team. Source: Soch Fact Check . Detections change from 4 to 2 of 10 visual configurations and from 5 to 1 of six MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 并删除Instagram标题、接触界面和评论。 已删除的文本明确披露了AI增强,并包含一个名为图像假的注释. 来源报告一个正合成ID检查;这是源报的核查,不是我们团队运行的工具. 资料来源:索奇事实。 检查。 探测器从10个视觉配置中的4个变为2个,从6个MLLM的5个变为1个.

blocks.en: Figure A1 : Two acquired/processed pairs illustrate why target-region crops are applied. The displayed versions are the actual benchmark inputs. Counts describe detections of these examples, not evidence that any one removed cue caused a prediction change.
blocks.zh: 图A1:两对已获得/加工的对说明为什么使用目标区域作物。 显示的版本是实际的基准输入. 伯爵描述了对这些例子的检测,而不是任何被移除的提示引起预测变化的证据.

blocks.en: Appendix C Representative Shared Misses
blocks.zh: 附录C 代表 共享密钥

blocks.en: On processed inputs, 191 of 407 images (46.93%) are missed by at least 12 of the 16 evaluated configurations. Figure A2 illustrates the diversity of this subset, spanning local edits, fabricated scenes, and AI reconstruction. Counts refer to processed inputs; the linked sources document the associated generation or editing.
blocks.zh: 在已处理的输入中,有407幅图像中的191幅(46.93%)被16幅评估配置中的至少12幅错过. 图A2说明了这一子集的多样性,包括地方编辑、编造场景和AI重建。 计数是指已处理的输入;链接源文档相关生成或编辑.

blocks.en: (a) Clothing edits Missed by 14/16 Luxury-brand clothing and logos were added to a photograph of Australian ministers, as shown by comparison with the original press photograph. Source: AAP FactCheck .
blocks.zh: (a) 在澳大利亚部长的照片中添加了14/16号奢侈品牌的服装和标志,与原始新闻照片进行比较。 资料来源:AAP事实检查。

blocks.en: (b) Fabricated historical image Missed by 13/16 A black-and-white image of a baby seat outside a car circulated as a historical photograph. Snopes reports a positive SynthID check. Source: Snopes .
blocks.zh: (b) 13/16所错失的虚构历史图像 汽车外婴儿座的黑白图像作为历史照片流通。 Snopes报告一个正合成ID检查. 资料来源:Snopes。

blocks.en: (c) Object insertion Missed by 12/16 A bus was added to a real Mumbai flyover scene, creating the appearance of a vehicle stuck where the lanes narrow. Source: Alt News .
blocks.zh: (c) 在真正的孟买飞行场景中增加了12/16漏掉的一辆公共汽车,造成车辆卡在车道狭窄处。 资料来源:Alt News。

blocks.en: (d) Fabricated disaster scene Missed by 12/16 The purported aerial view of a hurricane-damaged Jamaican hospital differs from its actual layout. Full Fact reports confirmation of a SynthID watermark. Source: Full Fact .
blocks.zh: (d) 制造的灾害场景于12/16日失明,据称对飓风破坏的牙买加医院的空中观察与其实际布局不同。 完整的事实报告确认一个合成ID水印. 资料来源:全事实。

blocks.en: (e) Generative fashion imagery Missed by 12/16 Mango’s disclosed generative-AI campaign depicts a model in a desert setting, combining photographic advertising style with generated imagery. Source: invidis .
blocks.zh: (e) 12/16 Mango披露的Generative-AI运动错过的基因时尚图像描绘了沙漠环境中的模型,将摄影广告风格与生成的图像相结合。 资料来源:Invidis。

blocks.en: (f) Reconstructed details Missed by 16/16 AI reconstruction of low-resolution footage introduces clear facial and clothing details that the original recording does not establish. Source: Lead Stories .
blocks.zh: (f) 16/16 AI重构的低分辨率镜头的重构细节引入了清晰的面部和服装细节,而原始录音并没有证实这些细节. 资料来源:主要故事。

blocks.en: Figure A2 : Representative shared misses across public affairs, historical imagery, infrastructure, disasters, advertising, and eyewitness-style images. Misses occur across both modified photographs and generated content, rather than a single visual genre.
blocks.zh: 图A2:代表分享了公共事务、历史图像、基础设施、灾害、广告和目击图像等各种缺失情况。 Misses发生在修改的照片和生成的内容之间,而不是一个单一的视觉流派.

blocks.en: Appendix D External Evaluation Coverage
blocks.zh: 附录D

blocks.en: Visual detectors use complete evaluation lists. MLLMs use fixed 2,000-image lists for EvalGEN, UnivFD, AIGIBench, Chameleon, and RRDataset. Their results on these five datasets carry † \dagger in the main paper’s Table 2. Synthbuster, SynthWildX, WildRF, and ITW-SM use the full evaluation lists for every method. Both WildAIGC-Bench versions are evaluated in full.
blocks.zh: 视觉探测器使用完整的评价清单. MLLMs对EvalGEN,UnivFD,AIGIBENCH,Chameleon,和RRDataset使用固定的2000图像列表. 他们在这五个数据集上的结果在主要论文的表2中标注了\dagger,Synthbuster,SynthWildX,WildRF,以及ITW-SM对每一种方法都使用完整的评价清单. WildAIGC-Bench两个版本都得到了全面的评价.

blocks.en: Table A2 reports the evaluation sizes and class composition. The same subsets are used across MLLMs.
blocks.zh: 表A2报告评价规模和类别组成。 相同的子集被跨 MLLMs 使用.

blocks.en: Table A2: Evaluation sizes and class composition for MLLMs. EvalGEN contains AI images only.
blocks.zh: 表A2: MLLMs的评价规模和类组成。 EvalGEN只包含AI图像.

blocks.en: The sampled subsets are fixed across methods, with sampling seed 42.
blocks.zh: 取样的子集被固定在各种方法之间,抽样种子42。

blocks.en: Appendix E Inference Configurations
blocks.zh: 附录 推论配置

blocks.en: Tables A3 and A4 summarize the inference settings. Each method uses a fixed operating rule across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 表A3和A4概述了推断设置。 每种方法都采用跨越基准的固定操作规则。

blocks.en: E.1 Visual Detectors
blocks.zh: E.1 视觉探测器

blocks.en: All visual detectors classify an image as AI-generated when the recorded fake-class score is strictly greater than 0.5. No prompt is used. Table A3 lists checkpoint identifiers and preprocessing settings used in evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有视觉探测器在录制的假类分数严格大于0.5时,将一个图像归类为AI生成. 未使用快捷键 。 表A3列出了评价中使用的检查站标识符和预处理设置.

blocks.en: Table A3: Visual detector configurations. Weight filenames are included for the evaluated open-source checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 表A3:视觉探测器配置. 经评估的开放源码检查站包括重量文件名。

blocks.en: Score interpretation. DRCT, AIDE, Effort, and OmniAID output a softmax fake-class probability (DRCT equivalently as one minus the real-class probability); DDA, B-Free, PGC, CO-SPY, and PE output a sigmoid fake probability. All visual detectors use the same >0.5 decision rule, applied to the fake-class score.
blocks.zh: 分数解释. DDCT,AIDE,Effort,和OmniAID输出一个软马克假级概率(DRCT等值为1减去真级概率);DDA,B-Free,PGC,CO-SPY,和PE输出一个sigmoid假概率. 所有视觉探测器都使用相同的>0.5决定规则,适用于假类分数.

blocks.en: E.2 MLLMs and Prompts
blocks.zh: E.2 微调和提示

blocks.en: MLLM outputs are interpreted as binary real/fake decisions. The three general-purpose MLLMs use the same system and user prompts as Veritas++, in all evaluations.
blocks.zh: MLLM输出被解释为二进制真实/假的决定. 三种通用的MLLM在所有评价中使用与Veritas++相同的系统和用户提示.

blocks.en: Table A4: MLLM settings. P1–P3 identify the prompt descriptions below.
blocks.zh: 表A4: MLLM设置. P1–P3识别以下的即时描述.

blocks.en: P1: FakeVLM. The recorded user prompt is: “Is this image real or fake? Answer real or fake.”
blocks.zh: P1:假VLM. 记录的用户提示是:“这是真实的还是假的? 答真伪. “

blocks.en:
P2: BusterX++. The prompt requests an authenticity analysis followed by a boxed A/B answer (A: real; B: fake): <image>
Please analyze whether there are any inconsistencies or
obvious signs of forgery in the image, and finally come to
a conclusion: Is this image real or fake?

Then, just answer this MCQ with a single letter:
Q: Is this image real or fake?
Options:
A) real
B) fake

Put the final answer in \boxed{...}
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2018-09-29). P2: Buster QQ. 提示请求进行真实性分析,然后是框式A/B回答(A:真实;B:假):<图像>
请分析是否有任何不一致之处或
图像中明显有伪造痕迹 最后终于出现了
结论: 这是真实的还是假的?

然后,只要用一个字母回答这个MCQ:
问:这是真实的还是假的?
选项 :
A) 真实
B) 伪造

将最后的答案放入\ boxed{...}

blocks.en: P3: Veritas++ and general-purpose MLLMs. The recorded system prompt is: You are an expert visual analyst. Please think about the question as if you were a human pondering deeply. It’s encouraged to include self-reflection or verification in the reasoning process. Then, give a final verdict within tags. The user prompt is: “Is this image real or fake?”
blocks.zh: P3:Veritas++和通用MLLMs. 记录的系统提示是: 你是一个专家视觉分析师。 请想一想这个问题 就像你是一个人类深思熟虑。 在推理过程中, 那就在标签内做出最后裁决 用户提示是:“这是真实的还是假的? “

blocks.en: Output interpretation. Binary labels are extracted from the model’s answer: real/fake text for FakeVLM, the boxed A/B choice for BusterX++, and the final real/fake verdict for Veritas++ and the three API models.
blocks.zh: 产出口译。 二进制标签从模型的答案中提取:假VLM的真/假文本,BusterX++的盒式A/B选择,Veritas++的最终真实/假判决和三个API模型.
